figures.caption: Tē 24 tô:—Siōng-chì-kut, kap nñg-thâu-phok-kun : a, b, téng-bīn nñg thâu ê khí-sí chiū-sī tī keng-kah-kut ; P, sī kun-thêng-chí chiū-sī tī jiâu-kut; chit-ê sī lėk-tiám ; F, siōng-phok-kut ê hā-toan, sī jiâu-kut kap chhioh-kut ê siōng-toan tín-tāng ê pō-ūi ; chit-ê sī chi-tiám ; W, chhiú, chiū-sī tiōng-tiám.
